id.description:
Output only. Unique identifier for the statement line.
Values are of the form `stln_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

statementId.description:
Output only. Identifier of the parent statement.
Values are of the form `stmt_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

rowIndex.description: Output only. Line index inside the source statement (0-indexed).

dateStr.description: Output only. Original date string from the CSV.

description.description: Output only. Original description string from the CSV.

amount.description: Output only. Amount in account cents.

status.description: Current reconciliation status of the line.

matchedTransactionId.description:
Output only. Linked transaction ID once committed/completed.
Values are of the form `txn_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

reference.description: Output only. Bank confirmation number or wire reference.

match.description: Match line to an existing transaction.

suggestions.description: Output only. Grouped suggestions resolved dynamically by the matching engine.

version.description: Output only. Optimistic concurrency control version identifier.

v1StatementLine.description: StatementLine represents a parsed transaction row from the uploaded statement.

v1StatementLineStatus.description:
Status defines whether the line is matched to the ledger.

 - UNMATCHED: Unmatched line item.
 - MATCHED: Matched to an existing transaction.
 - IMPORTED: Imported as a new transaction.
 - SKIPPED: Explicitly skipped/ignored.

v1StatementStatus.description:
Status defines the lifecycle phase of the statement.

 - IN_PROGRESS: In progress draft statement undergoing reconciliation.
 - COMPLETED: Completed statement with all lines successfully matched or imported.

topic.description: Output only. The event topic name.

pending.description: Output only. Number of deliveries waiting in the queue.

processing.description: Output only. Number of deliveries currently being processed.

completed.description: Output only. Number of deliveries successfully completed.

failed.description: Output only. Number of deliveries that have failed after max attempts.

total.description: Output only. Total number of deliveries recorded for this topic.

v1TopicMetrics.description: TopicMetrics represents status counters for a specific event topic.

id.description:
Output only. Unique identifier of the transaction.
Values are of the form `txn_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

budgetId.description:
Optional. Associated budget identifier.
Values are of the form `bud_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

periodId.description:
Optional. Associated period identifier.
Values are of the form `per_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

amount.description: Required. Absolute value of transaction in local currency cents (e.g. 10000 for $100.00).

amountInBase.description: Output only. Value converted to base currency cents.

createTime.description: Output only. System create timestamp.

updateTime.description: Output only. System update timestamp.

effectiveDate.description: Required. Execution/posting date (when funds reconcile in account balance).

accountId.description:
Optional. Associated account ID.
Values are of the form `acc_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

account.description: Output only. Hydrated minimal account info. Available only on FULL view.

budget.description: Output only. Hydrated minimal budget info. Available only on FULL view.

v1Transaction.description: Transaction represents a financial record in the space ledger.

id.description: Output only. Unique identifier of the budget.

name.description: Output only. User-friendly name of the budget.

v1TransactionBudgetInfo.description: BudgetInfo wraps minimal budget details required for UI listing.

id.description:
Output only. Unique identifier.
Values are of the form `evt_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

txnId.description:
Required. Associated transaction ID.
Values are of the form `txn_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

metadata.description: Required. JSON metadata describing the change details (e.g. diff properties).

createTime.description: Output only. Event registration timestamp.

v1TransactionEvent.description: TransactionEvent represents a historical transaction lifecycle change.

v1TransactionType.description:
Type defines the direction and flow of funds.

 - EXPENSE: Expense transaction, subtracting from the account balance.
 - INCOME: Income transaction, adding to the account balance.
 - TRANSFER_OUT: Transfer out transaction, moving funds to another account.
 - TRANSFER_IN: Transfer in transaction, receiving funds from another account.
 - BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT: Balance adjustment transaction, reconciling account to real-world balance.

v1TransactionView.description:
View controls the hydration of related metadata.

 - BASIC: Returns transaction details without related account or budget info.
 - FULL: Hydrates complete structure including account and budget details.

id.description:
Output only. Unique identifier.
Values are of the form `txn_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

sourceAccountId.description:
Required. Source account ID.
Values are of the form `acc_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

destinationAccountId.description:
Required. Destination account ID.
Values are of the form `acc_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`.

sourceAmount.description: Required. Source amount in source account currency cents.

destinationAmount.description: Required. Destination amount in destination account currency cents.

createTime.description: Output only. Creation timestamp.

updateTime.description: Output only. Last update timestamp.

v1Transfer.description: Transfer represents a new transfer between accounts.

backup.description: Output only. The newly created backup entry.

user.description: Output only. The updated user resource reflecting the new access level.

sessionId.description: Output only. The unique identifier of the session.

userAgent.description: Output only. The User-Agent string associated with the session.

ipAddress.description: Output only. The IP address of the client that created the session.

createTime.description: Output only. The timestamp when the session was initialized.

lastUsedAt.description: Output only. The timestamp when the session was last utilized.

v1UserSession.description: UserSession represents an active user session resource.
